fields.description: For a payment that settles several invoices or credit notes. per_invoice: one line per invoice / credit note with its allocated amount; credit notes get the opposite S/H, and the lines add up to the bank amount. per_payment: one line with the net bank amount. Payments settling a single invoice always export as one line.
fields.label: Lines per Payment

fields.description: Document number in Belegfeld 1 of a payment line that belongs to one invoice. payment_entry: the Payment Entry number. invoice: the invoice / credit note number, so DATEV can match the payment to its open item (OPOS). The Payment Entry number stays in Beleginfo - Inhalt 1 either way. Lines without a single invoice (per_payment with several invoices, unallocated amounts) keep the Payment Entry number.
